title: 第九十七章  黑风驹
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾淮摸了摸自己的袖袋，脸上露出一抹有些无奈的笑意。

前些日子卢秋闻给他的那些银子，大半都已经被他砸进了城东的酒庄里。

如今他身上满打满算，也就只剩下一千两左右的银票。

“少爷，咱们真要全押上吗？”

苏莹在一旁小声问着，清秀的脸上带着一丝担忧。

“押，为什么不押？”

顾淮洒脱一笑，将那一叠银票递给了一旁的庄家。

“李兄既然如此有把握，本少爷自然要舍命陪君子。”

庄家接过银票，看清数额后，有些诧异地看了顾淮一眼。

“一千两，押李少将军的黑风驹。”

庄家高声唱和，将银票收了下去。

没过多久，随着一阵清脆的铜锣声，马场上的气氛瞬间被推向了高潮。

一匹通体漆黑、高大威猛的骏马被马夫牵了出来。

那马身上的毛发黑亮得如同上好的绸缎，在阳光下折射出冰冷的光泽。

“瞧瞧，这就是黑风驹。”

“不愧是李老将军的座驾，当真是神骏非凡。”

围观的世家子弟们纷纷发出惊呼，眼中满是艳羡之色。

李少云站在马厩旁，双手环抱在胸前，神色得意到了极点。

他甚至还挑衅般地朝着四周的人群拱了拱手。

“各位，想要赢钱的赶紧下注，晚了可就没位置了。”

李少云的语气极为臭屁。

然而，正因为黑风驹的名气太大，场中的庄家也不是傻子。

“黑风驹，一赔一点一。”

庄家有气无力地喊着这个极低的赔率。

显然，大家心里都清楚，这匹马赢面太大，根本没人敢开高赔率。

随着一声尖锐的哨音，比赛正式开始。

黑风驹如同一道黑色的闪电，瞬间从起点窜了出去。

它的速度极快，四蹄翻飞间，甚至在草场上带起了一阵狂风。

旁边的几匹马虽然也算不错，但在黑风驹面前，简直就像是老牛拉破车一般。

比赛几乎没有任何悬念。

黑风驹一路遥遥领先，最终以绝对的优势跨过了终点。

“赢了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Huai touched his sleeve pocket, with a helpless smile on his face.

Most of the money Lu Qiuwen gave him a few days ago has been thrown into the winery in the east of the city.

Now that he has a lot of money left, he only has about a thousand taels of silver notes left.

"Master, do we really want to go all-in?"

Su Ying asked quietly from the side, with a trace of worry on her delicate face.

"Paid, why not?"

Gu Huai smiled freely and handed the stack of banknotes to the banker on the side.

"Since Brother Li is so sure, I will naturally sacrifice my life to accompany you."

The dealer took the banknote and after seeing the amount, he looked at Gu Huai with some surprise.

"One thousand taels to guard Major General Li's Black Wind Horse."

The banker sang loudly and took the banknote.

Not long after, with the crisp sound of a gong, the atmosphere on the racecourse was instantly pushed to a climax.

A black, tall and mighty horse was led out by the groom.

The horse's hair was as black and shiny as fine silk, reflecting an icy luster in the sunlight.

"Look, this is the Black Wind Horse."

"It is indeed the car of General Li. It is truly an extraordinary horse."

The children of the aristocratic families who were watching all exclaimed in surprise, their eyes full of envy.

Li Shaoyun stood beside the stable, with his hands folded in front of his chest, looking extremely proud.

He even arched his hands provocatively towards the crowd around him.

"Everyone, if you want to win money, bet quickly. If you are late, you will not be able to get a seat."

Li Shaoyun's tone was extremely disgusting.

However, just because Hei Fengju is so famous, the bookmaker in the field is not a fool.

"Black Wind Horse, pay one point to one point."

The bookmaker feebly shouted the extremely low odds.

Obviously, everyone knows that this horse has a great chance of winning, and no one dares to offer high odds.

With a sharp whistle, the game officially begins.

The black wind horse was like a black lightning, instantly rushing out from the starting point.

Its speed was extremely fast, its hooves flying around, and it even caused a gust of wind on the grassland.

Although the horses next to him were pretty good, in front of the black wind horse, they were like old oxen pulling a broken cart.

There is almost no suspense in the game.

Black Wind Horse was far ahead all the way, and finally crossed the finish line with an absolute advantage.

"Won."
